Sobre.title: Hi, I'm Mika
Sobre.paragraph1: I'm a clinical psychologist and I believe therapy doesn't have to be a serious, distant place — it can (and should) be a warm, human space full of good energy, even when the subject hurts.
Sobre.paragraph2: I work with integrative therapy, combining techniques from different approaches to build a process that makes sense for your story — not a ready-made template.
